/*selectMasterMpRqBuyerQuotationReceiptSendCntPopList*/ SELECT X.BUYER, MAX(X.BUYER_NAME) AS BUYER_NAME, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM( SELECT A.BUYER, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.buyer) AS BUYER_NAME, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION FROM KEPRQDT A, (SELECT BUYER FROM BUYEROWN WHERE USER_ID=#{USER_ID}) M
WHERE A.BUYER ='KRDOOD0001' AND A.BUYER=M.BUYER
WHERE A.BUYER=M.BUYER AND A.BUYER<>'KRDOOD0001'
AND A.BUYER IN ( SELECT A.BUYER FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3 WHERE COD3.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD3.TYPE = 'CMPY' AND COD3.CODE1= 'ALL' AND COD3.CODE2 = #{USER_ID} UNION ALL SELECT MNG.BUYER FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3, MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE COD3.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD3.TYPE = 'CMPY' AND COD3.CODE1= MNG.KEP_DEPT AND COD3.CODE2 = #{USER_ID} AND MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND MNG.STATUS = 'C' UNION ALL SELECT BUYER FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND STATUS = 'C' AND KEP_USER_ID = #{USER_ID} UNION ALL SELECT COD.CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD , ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE COD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE = 'CMPY' AND COD.CODE1 = CMPY.COM_CODE AND COD.CODE2 = #{USER_ID} AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TEXT2 AND TEXT3 )
AND A.KEP_USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND A.SO_CA_FLAG='SO' AND A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE=0 AND A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG ^='Y' AND A.RECV_FLAG NOT IN('GD','PM') AND (A.STATUS = 'C' OR A.STATUS = 'R')) X GROUP BY X.BUYER

/*selectMasterMpRqQuotationItemMdreqHistList*/ SELECT REQ.BUYER ,(SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = REQ.BUYER) AS BUYER_NM ,REQ.QUOTATION_NO ,REQ.QUOTATION_SEQ ,REQ.REVISION ,REQ.ITEM_MD_REVISION ,REQ.ITEM_MD_STATUS ,REQ.ITEM_MD_REQ_USER_ID ,(SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = REQ.ITEM_MD_REQ_USER_ID) AS ITEM_MD_REQ_USER_NM ,TO_CHAR(REQ.ITEM_MD_REQ_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS ITEM_MD_REQ_DATE ,REQ.ITEM_MD_REQ_NOTE ,REQ.ITEM_MD_USER_ID ,(SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = REQ.ITEM_MD_USER_ID) AS ITEM_MD_USER_NM ,TO_CHAR(REQ.ITEM_MD_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS ITEM_MD_DATE ,REQ.ITEM_MD_REQ_IMAGE_KEY ,DECODE(REQ.ITEM_MD_REQ_IMAGE_KEY,'',2,3) AS ITEM_MD_REQ_IMAGE_KEY_IMG FROM KEP_ITEM_MD_REQ REQ WHERE REQ.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND REQ.QUOTATION_NO = #{st_quotation_no} AND REQ.QUOTATION_SEQ = #{st_quotation_seq} AND REQ.REVISION = #{st_revision} ORDER BY REQ.ITEM_MD_REVISION DESC

/*selectQuotationRemarkList*/ SELECT MNG.BUYER ,MNG.QUOTATION_NO ,MNG.QUOTATION_SEQ ,MNG.REVISION ,MNG.ADD_USER_ID ,(SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = MNG.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NM ,TO_CHAR(MNG.ADD_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS ADD_DATE ,MNG.ADD_NOTE ,(SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = MNG.CHANGE_USER_ID) AS CHANGE_USER_NM ,TO_CHAR(MNG.CHANGE_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS CHANGE_DATE ,MNG.SEQ ,MNG.IMAGE_KEY ,DECODE(MNG.IMAGE_KEY,'',2,3) AS IMAGE_KEY_IMG FROM KEP_RQDT_NOTE_MNG MNG WHERE MNG.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND MNG.QUOTATION_NO = #{st_quotation_no} AND MNG.QUOTATION_SEQ = #{st_quotation_seq} AND MNG.REVISION = #{st_revision} AND MNG.STATUS != 'D' ORDER BY MNG.ADD_DATE DESC
